description: Query one organization's append-only audit trail (read — viewer role): field-level changes with actor, source and before/after values. Filter by entity, control, action, actor, source, date or text.

action.description: Filter by action: create, update or delete

action_source.description: Filter by origin of the change: ui, api_key, mcp or system

actor_id.description: Filter by actor user UUID — platform alias of changed_by_user_id

changed_by_user_id.description: Filter by the user who made the change — obtain from scf_list_members

date_from.description: Include changes at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

date_to.description: Include changes at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

entity_id.description: Filter by the changed entity's UUID

entity_type.description: Filter by exact entity type as written in the log, e.g. scoped_control, evidence_file, audit_engagement, vendor — unsure of the spelling? use search_text

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0)

request_id.description: Filter by request correlation ID — groups every change one API call made

scf_id.description: Filter by SCF control ID in DOMAIN-NN format

search_text.description: Case-insensitive search across entity_type, field_name, old_value and new_value

name: scf_get_audit_log
